headline: Leakage-free validation and benchmarking reshape omics ML biomarker discovery
label: Validated Omics Machine Learning Tools
summary: Omics-based predictive and biomarker models increasingly require leakage-free validation and explicit benchmarks against established methods.
synthesis: The common thread is the design of validation around omics-based predictive and biomarker models. Several items enforce evaluation hygiene: DSEN reports leakage-free cross-validation across 265 drugs, and the keloid workflow uses study-aware cross-validation to harmonize 81 samples from 13 studies. Benchmarks treat established methods as explicit references, as in classical ML models on TCGA-BRCA data and tumor-naive ctDNA quantification across colorectal, lung and breast cancer plasma. Other items release tools, including the CNSigs R package for copy-number mutational signatures and MLMarker, which provides SHAP-based explanations. The items are heterogeneous in method, spanning logic modeling, histopathology deep learning, fragmentomics, and single-cell prototype routing, so the shared element is not a single algorithm but checkable, distributable analysis procedures.
